from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationRelationship(BaseModel):
    """A directed citation relationship found within a single paper's text."""
    source_paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper containing the reference (the current document)")
    target_paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being referenced (found in the bibliography)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    citation_relationships: list[CitationRelationship]
